## Load data

```{r cars}
# single-object exposure w frequency manipulation (mostly/all kids) - 
ad <- read_csv("data/act_data.csv") %>%
  filter(!startsWith(trial_type, "fam")) %>% # eliminate: fam-learning familiar-test
  rename(image1 = available_image1,
         image2 = available_image2,
         image3 = available_image3,
         image4 = available_image4,

  mutate(choice_image = sub("stims/", "", choice_image),

         image1 = sub("stims/", "", image1),
         image2 = sub("stims/", "", image2),
         image3 = sub("stims/", "", image2),
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
get_experiment_cooc_matrix <- function(dat, experiment_name) {
  xd_s <- subset(dat, experiment_name==experiment_name & subject==unique(dat$subject)[1])
  voc = sort(na.omit(unique(unlist(xd_s %>% select(starts_with("label"))))))
  refs = sort(na.omit(unique(unlist(xd_s %>% select(starts_with("image"))))))
  coocs <- matrix(0, nrow=length(voc), ncol=length(refs))
  row.names(coocs) = voc
  colnames(coocs) = refs
  return(coocs)
}

get_experiment_cooc_matrix(ad, "1") 
get_experiment_cooc_matrix(ad, "2A") # exposure phase: choice_image and choice_audio <- passive (not active)
get_experiment_cooc_matrix(ad, "2B") # ""
get_experiment_cooc_matrix(ad, "2C") # ""

```

```{r}
# learning     selection          test 
#       9             4             6 


# on trial_type=="selection", model should only learn choice_label -> choice_image
# (on selection trials, image1 - image6 / image8 (adults) encode the available options)

get_experiment_cooc_matrix(xd, "Experiment 1")
get_experiment_cooc_matrix(xd, "Experiment 2")
get_experiment_cooc_matrix(xd, "Experiment 3")
get_experiment_cooc_matrix(xd, "Experiment S1")

run_subject_trials <- function(xd_s) {
  coocs <- get_experiment_cooc_matrix(xd_s, xd_s[1,]$experiment_name)
  # iterate over trials, handle training and selection/test trials
  for(i in 1:nrow(xd_s)) {
    # should ignore 
    refs = setdiff(unlist(xd_s[i,] %>% select(starts_with("image"))), NA)
    labs = setdiff(unlist(xd_s[i,] %>% select(starts_with("label"))), NA)
    coocs[labs,refs] = coocs[labs,refs] + 1
  }
  return(coocs)
}

run_subject_trials(xd_s)
```


```{r}
get_subject_trial_ordering <- function(xd_s) {
  xd_train <- xd_s %>% filter(trial_type!="test")
  voc = sort(na.omit(unique(unlist(xd_s %>% select(starts_with("label"))))))
  refs = sort(na.omit(unique(unlist(xd_s %>% select(starts_with("image"))))))
  w_inds = which(startsWith(names(xd_train), "label"))
  o_inds = which(startsWith(names(xd_train), "image"))
  words = list() # words per trial
  objects = list() # objs per trial
  for(i in 1:nrow(xd_train)) {
    if(xd_train[i,]$trial_type=="learning") {
      words[[i]] = na.omit(unlist(xd_train[i,w_inds]))
      objects[[i]] = na.omit(unlist(xd_train[i,o_inds]))
    } else if(xd_train[i,]$trial_type=="selection") {
      words[[i]] = unlist(xd_train[i,]$choice_label)
      objects[[i]] = unlist(xd_train[i,]$choice_image)
    }
  }
  return(list(words = words, objs = objects, 
              voc=voc, refs=refs)) # for indexing
}

ord <- get_subject_trial_ordering(xd_s)
```
